title: fix(plugin-list)!: a non-grid view's selection bar draws only actions the object declares (#30394)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuEHQyuPNhMoPYnP8JdznESK)_
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVzvtWN68zb2r9z2zy

Fixes #30394

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `@object-ui/plugin-grid` now exports `resolveBulkActions` and `useUndeclaredActionNamesWarning` (with the `ActionLabelResolver`, `NamedActionDef`, `UndeclaredActionNameKey`, `UndeclaredActionNamesAddress` and `UndeclaredActionNamesBasis` types), so `@object-ui/plugin-list` reuses the grid's fold and warning instead of a second copy. The warning's address gains an optional `component`, defaulting to `ObjectGrid`, so the grid's message is byte-identical. This PR both widens (those exports) and narrows (the non-grid bar no longer draws an undeclared bare name), so the arm is `(narrowing)`: seat patch round on the Check Changeset red, after claim amendment 6658495307 had written `(widening)`. Owes a `TIER_DEFAULT` review for the export widening and a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review for the narrowing below.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed (an undeclared bare `bulkActions` name no longer draws in a non-grid view, matching #30387 on the grid)
Skills-docs: none owed — `skills/**` teaches no handler-only bulk action name (searched `skills/` for `bulkActions` examples); `content/docs/ui/**` already names only declared actions.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：看板、日历、画廊等非表格视图的选择栏，改成和表格同一条规则：视图 `bulkActions` 里的裸名字，只有对象声明了同名操作才画按钮，用声明的标签；删除照旧走自己的路径；没声明的名字不画，开发态控制台打一行警告点名。
- 为什么改：#30169 裁决 C 后表格已不画未声明的操作（PR #30387），但切到看板等视图，勾选记录后仍会出现幽灵按钮（比如被禁用模块扣下的「Create Campaign」），点了只弹「不可执行」。
- 风险与回滚：plugin-list 新增对 plugin-grid 的 peer 依赖（控制台 app-shell 本来就同时装两包）；plugin-grid 入口多两个导出，警告消息多一个可选的组件名字段，表格输出不变。若仓外宿主靠前端接管一个未声明的名字，非表格视图里它的按钮会消失。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`（`nonGridBulkBar` 折叠与选择栏渲染）→ `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/undeclaredActionNames.ts`（可选 `component`）→ `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`（两个新导出）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.nonGridBulkDeclared-30394.test.tsx`，预期 4 条全过；去掉折叠（消融）时其中 3 条转红。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

ListView draws its own selection bar for every view but the grid (kanban, calendar, gallery, timeline, …). That bar mapped each `bulkActions` member straight to a button labelled by the humanized name, declared or not. #30169 (ruling C, comment 6651753071) made the grid draw only actions the object declares; this applies the same rule to the other bar, through the grid's own code.

- **`ListView.tsx`.** A new `nonGridBulkBar` memo folds `permittedBulkActions` (the existing delete gate is untouched) through plugin-grid's `resolveBulkActions`, with the canonical `delete` held out of the fold exactly as `ObjectGrid` holds it out. The bar draws, in authored order, `delete` (its own path, gate and per-record `visibleWhen` subset, unchanged) and each name the served object declares, under the declared label resolved through the app's i18n bundle (the grid's `localizeLabel`). Any other name draws nothing. A bar with nothing left to draw is not rendered. `useUndeclaredActionNamesWarning` names the undrawn names once in development, only while a non-grid view is on screen (the grid warns for itself) and only once the object schema read has settled; with no schema in hand (no `getObjectSchema`, or the read failed) the names are reported as unread, never as undeclared, the grid's reading.
- **`plugin-grid/src/undeclaredActionNames.ts`.** `UndeclaredActionNamesAddress` gains an optional `component` that heads the message; omitted, it is `ObjectGrid`, so every grid message is byte-identical. ListView passes `ListView` and the view on screen as `blockType`: `[ObjectUI] ListView bulkActions: kanban (objectName: 'lead') — 1 name matches no action the object declares, …`.
- **`plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`.** Exports `resolveBulkActions`, `useUndeclaredActionNamesWarning` and the types their signatures name.
- **`plugin-list/package.json`.** Declares `@object-ui/plugin-grid` as a peer (`workspace:^`) and dev (`workspace:*`) dependency, following its `@object-ui/plugin-detail` precedent. No cycle: plugin-grid does not depend on plugin-list. plugin-list's build externalizes `@object-ui/*`, so its dist does not bundle the grid. `pnpm-lock.yaml` moves by the three lines that declaration adds.
- **Fixtures.** `ListView.bulkDeleteVisibleWhen.test.tsx` and `ListView.permissions.test.tsx` used `archive` as their non-delete control without the object declaring it; both fixtures now declare `{ name: 'archive', label: 'Archive' }`, so the control still draws (moved pins, assertions unchanged).

## Why

Same defect as #30169, one more surface: after PR #30387 a list shown as a grid hides a name the object does not declare (for example an action a disabled package withholds), but the same list switched to kanban or gallery still drew a button for it, and pressing it toasted "not executable". The card asks for the grid's resolver to be reused rather than copied; plugin-list could not reach it (no dependency, not exported), measured and reported to the seat before plugin-grid was touched.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.nonGridBulkDeclared-30394.test.tsx` (gallery view, selection stubbed the way `ListView.bulkDeleteVisibleWhen.test.tsx` does): a declared name draws under its declared label and dispatches by name, `delete` draws in authored order, an undeclared name draws nothing and is named in one `ListView` warning; all-undeclared draws no bar; no `getObjectSchema` reports the names as unread; all-declared warns nothing.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/undeclaredActionNames.test.ts`: the message heads with `ObjectGrid` by default and with the address's `component` when given.

## Acceptance notes

- Importing the plugin-grid entry (`sideEffects: true`, it registers `object-grid` on import) did not disturb plugin-list's mocked registrations: the full plugin-list suite is green (below), which was the measured risk in the claim amendment's plan B.
- The non-grid bar still dispatches through the host's `onBulkAction(name, rows)`; promoted defs' params, confirm text and `visible` are not consulted on this bar (they never were). Unchanged by this PR.

## Verification

The `(narrowing)` arm owes the full dogfood battery on the final head; its reading goes to the seat.
